```json
{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "label_pos",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "primary_critique_focus",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Categorizes which aspect of a film the review centers on (plot, acting, screenplay, etc.). Well-separated, interpretable categories that can be cross-tabulated against sentiment to reveal which themes dominate positive vs negative reviews. Directly serves the query about theme differences."
    },
    {
      "name": "narrative_quality_signal",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable ordinal-ish categories (coherent/engaging vs convoluted/thin vs derivative) that are associational to sentiment without being a bare restatement of the label. Enables meaningful segmentation, though it correlates strongly with sentiment; still informative as a theme dimension."
    },
    {
      "name": "comparison_or_genre_context",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "External rhetorical dimension (whether reviewer compares to other films, contextualizes by genre, or references history/culture). Clean, well-separated categories orthogonal to the label, offering a genuinely exploratory relationship to compare against sentiment."
    },
    {
      "name": "technical_or_creative_root_cause",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Attributes the review's judgment to a source (writing, casting, direction, effects, budget). Interpretable, well-spread categories that support discovering which root causes align with positive vs negative sentiment. Strong EDA variable."
    },
    {
      "name": "recommendation_stance",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Captures explicit/implicit recommend/avoid stance. Interpretable and segmentable, but it is largely a near-proxy for sentiment polarity, so it partially restates the focus rather than opening an independent relationship; still usable for segmentation."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 5,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.82,
  "rationale": "As a set, these columns provide interpretable, well-separated categorical dimensions (critique focus, narrative quality, comparative context, root-cause attribution, recommendation stance) that can each be grouped and cross-tabulated against label_pos to explore how review themes differ by sentiment. Categories are human-readable and reasonably balanced rather than opaque scores or near-constant/fine-grained values. The main caveats are that narrative_quality_signal and recommendation_stance correlate very tightly with sentiment and thus partly restate the focus, but the remaining columns (especially primary_critique_focus, comparison_or_genre_context, and technical_or_creative_root_cause) supply genuinely orthogonal, thematically rich segmentation. Overall a strong realization of the exploratory-EDA claim."
}
```
